name: B10-0056/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Need for actions to address the continued oppression and fake elections in Belarus
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for actions to address the continued oppression and fake elections in Belarus
part_text:
The European Parliament says the presidential election in Belarus on 26 January 2025 is not a real election. It calls for the release of all political prisoners and for the European Union to keep and expand its sanctions against those responsible for repression. It also asks European Union countries to make it easier for Belarusians fleeing for political reasons to get visas and residence permits, and to keep documenting crimes by the regime.

- The European Union is asked to extend and widen sanctions on Belarusian officials; this affects those officials.
- European Union countries are asked to simplify visas and residence permits for Belarusians fleeing repression.
- The Parliament calls for the release of named political prisoners; this is an appeal, not a decision.
